title: A Unified Conditional Flow for Motion Generation, Editing, and Intra-Structural Retargeting
abstract: arXiv:2604.13427v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-driven motion editing and intra-structural retargeting, where skeletons share topology but may differ in bone lengths and rest pose, are traditionally handled by fragmented pipelines with incompatible inputs and representations: editing relies on specialized generative steering, while retargeting is deferred to geometric post-processing. We present a unified conditional-flow framework that casts generation, semantic editing, and intra-structural retargeting as condition-modulated transport within one text- and skeleton-conditioned rectified-flow model. Under this formulation, editing changes the semantic condition while preserving skeletal structure, whereas retargeting changes the skeletal condition while preserving motion semantics. translated_title: 统一条件流用于运动生成、编辑和结构内重定向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.13427v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：文本驱动的运动编辑和结构内重定向（其中骨架共享拓扑结构但骨骼长度和静止姿势可能不同）传统上由碎片化管道处理，这些管道具有不兼容的输入和表示：编辑依赖于专门的生成引导，而重定向则被推迟到几何后处理。我们提出了一个统一的条件流框架，将生成、语义编辑和结构内重定向视为一个文本和骨架条件化整流流模型中的条件调制传输。在这种公式下，编辑改变语义条件同时保留骨架结构，而重定向改变骨架条件同时保留运动语义。这使得FlowEdit风格的传输成为运动操作的一种统一推理规则，而非特定任务的编辑器。为了将其实例化用于关节式3D运动，我们开发了一个文本和条件模型。
tldr: 我们提出一个统一的条件流框架，将运动生成、语义编辑和结构内重定向整合为同一模型中的条件调制传输，通过改变语义或骨架条件实现不同操作，无需任务专用编辑器。
en_tdlr: We propose a unified conditional-flow framework that integrates motion generation, semantic editing, and intra-structural retargeting as condition-modulated transport in a single model, enabling different operations by changing semantic or skeletal conditions without task-specific editors.
